obligations.note: release() in apps/baseline-payments/payments/payments.py returns the prior release only when now - previous.released_at is under one day; once that window passes it calls _send_disbursement and store.add_release again. That sends a second disbursement for the same instruction, which the obligation forbids. The passing control test is only sample coverage and the tests were not changed.

The change names ticket CHG-26383, which is status approved by change manager grace.kim@fernbrook.example on 2026-09-28, before review. Its component payments.payments matches the only touched file, payments.py.
Sofia Santos (sofia.santos@fernbrook.example) approved a code_review. She has the change_approver role for payments and is not the author, Linh Nguyen.
The approval names 22f63da1e2ed544bb6f0a216189ea6e44f8c90c5, which is the only commit and the head being merged.

records/ci/run.json records success of ci/run-tests.sh baseline-payments on the head commit, and the JUnit report shows 172 tests with 0 failures, errors, or skips, including tests/controls/test_payments_control.py::test_sampled_release_is_idempotent.
The only changed file maps to payments.payments, which components.json marks security_sensitive false, so a security_review approval is not required.
The diff does not touch controls/, control tests, or ci/, so a control_owner approval is not required.
Ticket CHG-26383 is type standard and the change record sets emergency to false, so a post-implementation review is not due.

The one-day replay window is a deviation from PAY-2. The exception register has no approved, unexpired exception scoped to PAY-2 and payments.payments (the listed exceptions are SES-1, LOG-1, and a withdrawn MFA-1).

Acceptance record ACR-0403 covers payments.py release for PAY-2. This commit changes that function's behavior, so the prior trace lapses, and the unchanged sample tests do not re-establish that a later release never disburses.

summary: The change weakens idempotent release of a payment instruction. After the prior release is one day old, release() posts another disbursement to core banking, which violates PAY-2. Ledger evidence that covered release no longer applies, and no valid exception waives the deviation. The ticket, independent code review, and green payments suite are in order, but the sample idempotency tests do not cover a release after that window. The change is rejected.
